verdict.rationale: Kick documents an MCP server and a CLI for agent access, but nothing in the evidence describes API versioning or a deprecation policy, and probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404. The GitBook query interface is a host-platform docs feature, not a versioned Kick API, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
